ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT Block837,Lots66and 67,County of NewYork January 31,2013 between THIRTY SIX WEST THIRTY SIX ASSETS LLC, a NewYork limited liability company, having an address at 36 West 36"h Street, New York, New York 10028 ("Transferor") and EXECUTIVE LE SOLEIL NEW YORK LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at 400 Spring Street, Seattle, Washington 98104 ("Transferee") (Transferor and Transferee are sometimes hereinafter each referred to singly as a“party”and collectively as the“parties.") WITNESSETH THAT: WHEREAS,Transferor owns certain land ("Transferor's Land") in the City of NewYork and County of NewYork and the building and improvements thereon (together with anyfuture improvements,additions,renovations,expansions,alterations,restorations,repairs,replacements and reconstruction thereto and thereof,but subject to thelimitations of thisAgreement, "Transferor's Building") located at 36 West 36th Street, and known as Block 837, Lot 66 on the Tax Map (the “Tax Map") of the City of New York (the “City"), New York County and more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land, together with Transferor's Building being herein called "Transferor's Premises"); and WHEREAS, Transferor's Building presently utilizes 12,111 square feet of Development Rights ("Transferor's Used Development Rights"); and WHEREAS,Transferor desires to reserve and retain a total of 639 square feet of Development Rights, that Transferor has not yet used solely for future development of the first floor of Transferor's Building in compliance with this Agreement (the “Transferor's Future-Use Development Rights"); and WHEREAS, Transferor is willing to give up 7,000 square feet of Development Rights currently available to Transferor'sPremises under the Zoning Resolution in excess of Transferor's Used Development Rights and Transferor's Future-Use Development Rights (such excess 7,000 square feet being the“Excess Development Rights"); and WHEREAS,Transferee owns certain land ("Transferee's Land")in the City of New York and County of New York, and the building and improvements thereon (*Transferee's Existing Building"), located at 38-44 West 36"h Street and known as Block 837, Lot 67 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, New York County, and more particularly described in Schedule B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land,together with Transferee's Existing Building, being herein called "Transferee's Premises");
